 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Real Madrid welcome RB Leipzig to the Santiago Bernabeu on Wednesday, October 21, looking to make it three wins from three in the UEFA Champions League league phase.
 The Spanish side have won six points from their first two European games, beating Inter Milan 2-1 and then a dramatic 4-3 win against Roma. Meanwhile, Leipzig have three points after losing to Como and beating PSV Eindhoven 1-0. The German visitors are now on one of the toughest away trips in Europe as they try to make their way up the league-phase table.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Real Madrid vs. RB Leipzig Confirmed Team News
 Real Madrid will be without Rodrygo, who is recovering from a knee injury, and Ferland Mendy, who is still suffering from a hip issue. Raul Asencio is also out due to a leg injury. No other players are listed as missing in the current team news report.
 NurPhoto / Getty Images
 Vinicius Junior is available for European selection despite being suspended from his club. The Brazilian will be back in the squad alongside Kylian Mbappe, with Mourinho confirming the pair will be in the first 11. Jude Bellingham is also likely to be playing in a high-pressing midfield position.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Leipzig have two confirmed injury absences: hamstring problem-plagued Christoph Baumgartner and shoulder injury-hit Assan Ouedraogo. There are no other players listed as doubtful on either side in the latest report.
 Real Madrid vs. RB Leipzig Starting Lineups
 Real Madrid predicted XI (4-2-3-1): Thibaut Courtois; Federico Valverde, Ibrahima Konate, Dean Huijsen, Alvaro Carreras; Arda Guler, Aurelien Tchouameni; Yan Diomande, Jude Bellingham, Vinicius Junior; Kylian Mbappe.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement RB Leipzig predicted XI (4-2-3-1): Maarten Vandevoordt; Ridle Baku, Willi Orban, Castello Lukeba, David Raum; Ezechiel Banzuzi, Neil El Aynaoui; Brajan Gruda, Christopher Nkunku, Antonio Nusa; Romulo.
 Real Madrid's attacking prowess will provide Mourinho with some choices, but Leipzig's counterattack speed may put the home side under pressure. The visitors will have to play a disciplined game to keep Mbappe and Vinicius under control, especially if Madrid get the ball up and running early.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Real Madrid vs. RB Leipzig Start Time
 The match will be kicked off at 9 p.m. CEST on Wednesday, October 21 at the Santiago Bernabeu in Madrid.
